newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: KLASCO IN 17.2 MLN LITAS 5-MO PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: KLASCO IN 17.2 MLN LITAS 5-MO PROFIT.

text.p: Lithuania's state-run Klaipeda Stevedoring company (KLASCO) said on Friday its profit before tax in the first five months of the year was 17.15 million litas compared to 17.014 million litas in the same period of 1996.
Finance director Aldona Valasevichiene also told Reuters that the firm's profit before tax in May rose to 5.95 million litas from 4.58 million litas in May 1996.
"The company's income in the first five months of the year also rose to 92.43 million litas compared to 73.43 million litas in the same period in 1996," Valasevichiene said.
She added that income in May was 20.79 million litas.
Expenses were estimated at 75.275 million litas in the first five months of the year, of which 14.84 million litas in May.

The company reported earlier that it handled 3.84 million tones of cargos in the first five months of the year versus 2.78 million tonnes in the same period a year ago but it was expecting a slowdown during the summer months.
KLASCO handled 7.6 million tonnes of cargos in 1996.
The 90 percent state run firm is the bigest stevedoring company in Klaipeda port.
